m0-context.title: Load context and verify handoff
m0-context.imperative: Read handoff, templates, existing seams. Verify all required fields present.

postconditions.statement: handoff verified complete with all required fields

m1-variant-factory.title: Add make_synthesis_variant factory to decoupled_longitudinal.py
m1-variant-factory.imperative: Add a make_synthesis_variant(**hp) -> VariantFn factory that parametrizes all 6 HPs and returns a VariantFn compatible with the scoreboard seam. Promote the _DEFAULT_* constants to be the single source of truth. No behavior change to existing variant_synthesis.

postconditions.statement: make_synthesis_variant is importable and returns callable VariantFn; existing tests still pass

m2-calibration-module.title: Build src/physics/layer2/decoupled_calibration.py
m2-calibration-module.imperative: Create a calibration-harness module with pure functions: build_hp_grid(), aggregate_scores(case_results, variant_name) -> SeasonAgg, select_best_hp(grid_results) -> HPSet. Also add enumerate_season_cases(year, constructors_drivers) -> list[(year,gp,driver)]. All pure functions must be testable without FastF1.

postconditions.statement: decoupled_calibration.py importable; pure functions work on synthetic inputs

check.command: py -c "from src.physics.layer2.decoupled_calibration import build_hp_grid, aggregate_scores, select_best_hp; print('ok')"

constraints: no DB access (this gate is telemetry-driven)

m3-calibration-script.title: Build scripts/calibrate_decoupled_hp_2023Q.py
m3-calibration-script.imperative: Create the full-season runner script. Uses enumerate_season_cases(2023, constructors_drivers) + run_scoreboard from scoreboard.py with make_synthesis_variant per HP point + BUILTIN_VARIANTS as baselines. Aggregates scores, selects best HP, writes JSON report. Runs offline from data/telemetry cache.
constraints: offline only; no live FastF1 calls

m4-unit-tests.title: Add unit tests for calibration harness pure functions
m4-unit-tests.imperative: Add tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_decoupled_calibration.py covering build_hp_grid, aggregate_scores, select_best_hp with synthetic inputs. No FastF1 in tests.

postconditions.statement: new tests pass; full layer2 suite green

m5-run-sweep.title: Run calibration sweep over 2023-Q season from offline cache
m5-run-sweep.imperative: Run scripts/calibrate_decoupled_hp_2023Q.py --dry-run first to confirm session enumeration. Then run the full sweep. If offline cache is missing for any session, skip + log (not a stop condition unless >50% fail). Report how many sessions loaded vs total.

preconditions.statement: script built and unit tests pass

postconditions.statement: sweep completed; season pass-rate computed for decoupled vs defaults; at least 10 sessions scored

constraints: stop if calibration cannot run from offline cache (>50% fail)

m6-persist-hps.title: Persist calibrated HP set in named constants
m6-persist-hps.imperative: Promote the calibrated HP values into named constants in decoupled_longitudinal.py (or a small decoupled_hp.py config module). Update the _DEFAULT_* constants to the calibrated values and document the calibration basis in the module docstring. No inline hidden tuning.

postconditions.statement: calibrated constants named and documented; existing tests still pass

m7-reports.title: Write calibration reports to reports/physics/
m7-reports.imperative: Write reports/physics/decoupled_hp_calibration_2023Q.json and .md with: per-session knee_gap_vs_raw and ringing_ok, season aggregate pass-rates, chosen-HP vs VER/3-circuit-default comparison, honest statement on global vs per-class generalization.

postconditions.statement: both report files exist with key numbers

m8-verify.title: Final verification: tests + simplification_limits
m8-verify.imperative: Run py -m pytest tests/unit/physics/layer2/ -q and py -m src.utils.simplification_limits on touched paths. Record exact output.

postconditions.statement: all unit tests green; simplification_limits clean on touched paths
